_comment: ADR-037 register fragment - the-decision-as-a-walked-process task 2.3 (REQ-DWP-002). Changing a step's threshold recomputes the step (StepThresholdRecomputer, on every decision-stage update) and is recorded as an approval action with the old and the new value (`thresholdBefore`, `thresholdAfter`, fragment 80) and who made the change. This widens the action enum with `threshold-changed`; enums merge as a union, so every existing verb stays. Properties only, so no schema version moves.

action.title: Action
action.description: Widened with `threshold-changed`: an administrator changed the threshold of the step, which recomputed its outcome. The action carries the old and the new value in `thresholdBefore` and `thresholdAfter` (REQ-DWP-002).
